scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm fmt:check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @flaremo/site typecheck && pnpm --filter @flaremo/telegram-bot-example typecheck && pnpm --filter @flaremo/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @flaremo/worker typecheck && pnpm --filter @flaremo/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @flaremo/db typecheck && pnpm --filter @flaremo/domain typecheck && pnpm --filter @flaremo/memos typecheck && pnpm --filter @flaremo/plugins typecheck
scripts.typecheck:strict: pnpm --filter @flaremo/site typecheck:strict && pnpm --filter @flaremo/telegram-bot-example typecheck:strict && pnpm --filter @flaremo/web typecheck:strict && pnpm --filter @flaremo/worker typecheck:strict && pnpm --filter @flaremo/contracts typecheck:strict && pnpm --filter @flaremo/db typecheck:strict && pnpm --filter @flaremo/domain typecheck:strict && pnpm --filter @flaremo/memos typecheck:strict && pnpm --filter @flaremo/plugins typecheck:strict
scripts.typecheck:tsc: pnpm --filter @flaremo/site typecheck:tsc && pnpm --filter @flaremo/telegram-bot-example typecheck:tsc && pnpm --filter @flaremo/web typecheck:tsc && pnpm --filter @flaremo/worker typecheck:tsc && pnpm --filter @flaremo/contracts typecheck:tsc && pnpm --filter @flaremo/db typecheck:tsc && pnpm --filter @flaremo/domain typecheck:tsc && pnpm --filter @flaremo/memos typecheck:tsc && pnpm --filter @flaremo/plugins typecheck:tsc
scripts.deploy: pnpm deploy:preflight && pnpm --filter @flaremo/web build && pnpm deploy:bundle-check && pnpm migrate:remote && pnpm --filter @flaremo/worker deploy

DB.description: Cloudflare D1 database used as the source of truth for memos, users, relations, shares, settings, and attachment metadata.

ATTACHMENTS.description: Cloudflare R2 bucket used for attachment binaries, export bundles, and other object files.

FLAREMO_SINGLE_USER_EMAIL.description: Owner email used by the single-user runtime model.

FLAREMO_SINGLE_USER_NAME.description: Owner display name used by the single-user runtime model.

FLAREMO_DEPLOY_REPOSITORY.description: GitHub repository created for this deployment, in owner/repository form. FlareMo uses it only to link the owner to the repository's update workflow.
